title: Paint your own Doormat
seo_title: Paint Your Own Christmas Doormat Workshop in Bolivar, MO
description: This is a hands-on workshop where you choose your colors, add your personal touch, and paint a festive Christmas welcome mat for your door. Two people can share one mat for $25 total, each additional doormat is $25, and all supplies are provided. It takes place Saturday, November 28, 2026 at 1:30 PM at The Creative Root, 115 N Main Ave in Bolivar, MO; space is limited, so reserve through the link and tell the organizer whether one or two people will attend.
address: 115 N Main Ave, Bolivar, MO 65613-1517, United States, Bolivar, MO
